title: RelayCaching — Decoding KV Cache Reuse for LLM Collaboration
summary_zh: 免訓練的多 agent 推理加速：直接重用上游 agent 解碼階段的 KV cache 作為下游 prefill，僅在中間層帶內對稀疏 token 重算修正。三個實證觀察支撐重用前提 —— 宏觀高對齊、U 形逐層偏離、稀疏且跨層相關的逐 token 偏離。token 選擇取偏離準則（value 餘弦不匹配）與影響準則（累積解碼注意力＋尾端後綴）之聯集。達 >80% 重用、TTFT 最高 4.7×（長脈絡 9.2×），準確度貼近 full prefill。與我們最相關：唯一具真正逐 token 重要性評分的引用者，但其動作是加法式修正（還原對 full-prefill 的忠實度），非減法去污染，且不指名污染現象。
summary_en: Training-free multi-agent inference acceleration: directly reuses an upstream agent's decoding-phase KV cache as the downstream prefill, recomputing only sparse tokens inside a middle layer band. Three empirical observations license the reuse premise — high macro alignment, a U-shaped layer-wise deviation, and sparse inter-layer-correlated token deviation. Token selection is the union of a deviation criterion (value-cosine mismatch) and an influence criterion (accumulated decode attention plus trailing suffix). Achieves >80% reuse and up to 4.7× TTFT reduction (9.2× at long context) with near-full-prefill accuracy. Closest citer to our decontamination line: the only reuse method with genuine per-token importance scoring, but its action is additive rectification (restoring fidelity to full prefill), not subtractive decontamination, and it never names a contamination phenomenon.
